title: Made rapid crosses in the air
html_source: The sign of the cross, a ubiquitous Roman Catholic gesture used to convey a blessing or a prayer of supplication, involves moving your right hand vertically then horizontally in a shape recalling the Cross of Jesus’s crucifixion. While clergy and laypeople alike often perform a solo gesture with hand close to their own chest and head, a Catholic priest may perform the gesture with their arm extended outward to “bless” another person in front of them, as Mulligan does to Stephen here as part of his mock priest shtick.
